snippet.title: "Some of You May Die" - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4124920/Some_of_You_May_Die/

Some of You May Die is an overpowered hero autobattler where your upgrades level up just like your heroes do!  Overcome the challenging singleplayer campaign or go head to head against other players online.

Demo is available now on Steam!
